messages.text: Look at our goal and what is already built, then give me three fun small choices for what to make next.
After the current work, test the playable experience and fix the most noticeable problem.
After the current work, test the playable experience and fix the most noticeable problem.

Based on what you built, here are three small, playable next steps:

**Fix the echo bug** — The "cuz she was cuz she was" duplication happens because `resultIndex` doesn't reset when the browser internally restarts the audio service. We can track the last processed index and reject chunks that overlap with what we already have.

**Auto-restart on silence** — Mobile browsers stop listening after ~60 seconds of silence (even with `continuous=true`). We can catch the `onend` event and automatically restart the recognizer after a brief delay, appending new chunks to the same session buffer so you can record for an hour without touching the screen.

**Watch mode layout** — Detect small screens (<360px) and switch to an ultra-compact view: single-column cards showing only 2 lines per session, larger touch targets, and bottom-sheet controls instead of floating buttons — optimized for Wear OS or Apple Watch browsers.

Which one sounds fun to build?
